title: Why Did T. Rex Have Such Tiny Arms?
sources: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History: T. rex

beats.say: T. rex was a giant dinosaur. But its arms were super tiny! Why?
Hi! I'm Dash, your little dino buddy. Let's stomp back in time!
T. rex's arms were so short, they couldn't even reach its mouth!
Scientists are still finding out what those little arms were for. It's a dino mystery!
But T. rex had a super nose. Scientists think it could smell things far, far away.
Can you wiggle tiny T. rex arms? Be kind to every animal. See you in Dino World!

title: T. Rex Never Met Stegosaurus! Here's Why
sources: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History: Stegosaurus

beats.say: T. rex and Stegosaurus never met. Not even once! How come?
Hi! I'm Dash, your little dino buddy. Let's stomp back in time!
Stegosaurus lived about 150 million years ago. T. rex came much, much later.
So T. rex actually lived closer in time to us than to Stegosaurus! Wow!
Stegosaurus had big plates on its back, and a spiky tail called a thagomizer!
Can you say thagomizer? Be kind to every animal. See you in Dino World!

title: Brachiosaurus Was Taller Than a House!

beats.say: Can you reach the top of a tree? Brachiosaurus could! How?
Hi! I'm Dash, your little dino buddy. Let's stomp back in time!
Brachiosaurus had a super long neck, and it was taller than a house!
Its front legs were longer than its back legs, like a giraffe.
It stretched up high to munch leaves at the very top of the trees.
Can you stretch up tall like Brachiosaurus? Be kind to every animal. See you in Dino World!

title: Pteranodon Was NOT a Dinosaur!
sources: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History: Pterosaurs

beats.say: It flew with giant wings in dinosaur times. But it was not a dinosaur! What was it?
Hi! I'm Dash, your little dino buddy. Let's stomp back in time!
This is Pteranodon. It was a flying reptile called a pterosaur.
Its wings were wider than a car! It soared high over the sea.
Its name means toothless wing, because it had no teeth at all!
Can you flap your arms like giant wings? Be kind to every animal. See you in Dino World!
